answer: Episodic continuity probes. Each epoch, a key answers quizzes about its past work: what it argued at the March summit, whom it served first. Only the same persistent memory, archived on ferrous platters, holds that story. Steps: ledger digests past answers; graders add decoys; keys with contradicting or near-duplicate histories share one payout slot. A 100-clone farm pays 100 x 2GB stores at \$4/GB-month = \$800 plus \$1 per persona = \$900/month; one contradiction collapses the fleet. Like a sparrow that finds its exact nest: presence is proven by remembering the nest, not the tree.
